The Competent Authority/Director of the Institute reserves the right to accept or reject any or all applications without assigning any reason; the decision is final and binding in all aspects. Candidates are advised to keep checking the Institute's website on a regular basis for further information regarding the interview.

content_sections.heading: About ICAR-NIPB
content_sections.text: ICAR-National Institute for Plant Biotechnology is located at Lal Bahadur Shastri Building, Pusa Campus, New Delhi-110012. The posts are for a project funded by the Indian Council of Agricultural Research, and the engagement is purely on a contractual basis.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applications are invited from Indian nationals. Only candidates having the essential qualifications will be considered for the interview. Master's degree in Plant Molecular Biology/Biotechnology/Biochemistry/Life science/Bioinformatics/Basic Biological Science/Agriculture with 4/5 years of Bachelor's degree. Candidates having a post-graduate degree in basic sciences/relevant subject with 3 years Bachelor's degree and 2 years Master's degree should have National Eligibility Test (NET) qualification of ICAR/CSIR/ICMR or equivalent body/GATE as per ICAR OM No. Agril/Edn. / 6 / 27/2014-HRD dated 13th July 2015 and 9th October, 2015 of the council, along with 2 years of research experience. Research experience in plant molecular biology, gene cloning, construct development, plant transformation in rice, tissue culture, other wet lab work, development and analysis of transgenic plants, genome editing in plants, knowledge about bioinformatics tools, and scientific writing as evidenced from publication/fellowship/associateship/training. The upper age limit for the post of SRF, as per ICAR guidelines, is 35 years for male candidates and 40 years for female candidates. The application form asks for age as on the last date of receipt of application. The notice does not list any age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility details.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The emoluments are fixed at Rs. 37000/- + 30 % HRA per month. The project duration is one year from the date of appointment, extendable based on satisfactory performance. The notice's terms say the positions are purely temporary, on a contractual basis and initially offered for one year or till project duration, whichever is earlier. The positions can be terminated with one months' notice owing to any change in circumstances. The selected person has no right to claim employment or engagement in ICAR at the end of the contract period.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ICAR-NIPB Senior Research Fellow
content_sections.text: Fill the application form strictly in the format given in the notice; all fields are mandatory. It includes a passport-size photograph, category (UR, OBC, SC, ST, PH), educational qualifications, publications and experience. Prepare the complete CV and the self-attested scanned copies of the documents listed below. Put the CV and all documents in a single file (single pdf). Email the file to [email protected] till 29 November 2026. The notice does not print a subject line. Wait for the interview email. Applications are screened for eligibility, and only eligible candidates are called. Bring all original documents for verification at the interview. Application form in the notice's format, any one Photo ID (Aadhaar/PAN Card/DL/Passport/Voter ID etc.), complete CV Class 10 mark sheet and pass certificate; Class 12 mark sheet and pass certificate Graduation mark sheet/Transcript and degree certificate; Post-Graduation mark sheet/Transcript and degree certificate Experience certificate (as and where applicable) No-Objection Certificate (essentially required if currently employed, as and where applicable) Conversion factor from CGPA to percentage, wherever applicable PhD degree certificate and PhD mark-sheet (as and where applicable) Copy of publications and research papers, if any NET/GATE qualified scorecard/certificate (as and where applicable) SC/ST/OBC Non-Creamy Layer/PH certificate (as and where applicable) Any other relevant documents Candidates who fail to send the documents mentioned above are liable to have their candidature cancelled. Claims made in the application form must be backed by documentary evidence, and an experience certificate issued by the competent authority must be enclosed to claim experience.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications are screened for eligibility as per the qualification criteria. Only candidates found eligible are called for the walk-in interview. The interview date is to be announced, tentatively in the month of December, and will be announced in the email only. Eligible candidates must bring all original documents for verification at the interview. The notice does not mention a venue or time.

faq.question: Q1. How many Senior Research Fellow posts are advertised by ICAR-NIPB?
faq.answer: ICAR-NIPB has advertised two Senior Research Fellow posts on the National Professor project. The number of posts may increase or decrease depending on the Institute's requirement and running projects with the same essential qualifications.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for ICAR-NIPB SRF?
faq.answer: The CV and documents must be emailed till 29 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for ICAR-NIPB SRF?
faq.answer: A Master's degree in Plant Molecular Biology/Biotechnology/Biochemistry/Life science/Bioinformatics/Basic Biological Science/Agriculture with 4/5 years of Bachelor's degree. Candidates with a 3-year Bachelor's and 2-year Master's degree need NET (ICAR/CSIR/ICMR or equivalent)/GATE and 2 years of research experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for ICAR-NIPB SRF?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 35 years for male candidates and 40 years for female candidates, as per ICAR guidelines.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the ICAR-NIPB Senior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: The emoluments are Rs. 37000/- + 30 % HRA per month.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for ICAR-NIPB SRF?
faq.answer: Email the CV in the notice's application form format, with self-attested scanned documents in a single file, to [email protected] till 29 November 2026.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Applications are screened for eligibility, and only eligible candidates are called for a walk-in interview. The date will be announced by email only, tentatively in December.

faq.question: Q8. Is HRA paid on top of the Rs. 37000 pay?
faq.answer: The notice prints the pay as Rs. 37000/- + 30 % HRA, so HRA at 30 % is shown along with the Rs. 37000/- emoluments.

faq.question: Q9. Is the ICAR-NIPB SRF post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The positions are purely temporary and contractual, initially for one year or till project duration, whichever is earlier, and can be terminated with one months' notice.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA would be given for appearing in the interview.
